description: DiligenceOps: submit one policy excerpt, such as an insurance, warranty or service policy. The signed brief states the coverage, the exclusions as items, the limits by kind (per claim, aggregate, per item, deductible, copay) with their amounts, and the conditions a claim must meet with their time limits, each quoted, and lists what the excerpt does not state. POST /api/policy-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-terms-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the policy, recorded in the brief.

text.description: One policy excerpt, such as an insurance policy, warranty or service policy, up to 256 KB.
